title: czwf-2005-heavyweight
label: Undertaker

won.source: The fed's own served Monday Night Adrenaline 11-21 broadcast: the Undertaker defeats reigning champion Iron Bull in a Double Tables Match, "the winner of this match, and new CZWF Heavywieght Championship champion, the Undertaker!!!"

how: Won a Double Tables Match, sending Iron Bull through a table — part of an already-ongoing rivalry the fed's own recap calls a "seesaw gone wrong."
note: The held record's last-attested state of this title; no further title-change document survives.

how: Defeated by the Undertaker in a Double Tables Match on Monday Night Adrenaline (11-21), sent through a table to lose the title.
